fixed.explanation: The generic ValueError in IntervalArray._validate didn't say which intervals broke the ordering rule. The fix computes a mask of positions where left > right and reports up to the first 5 offending positions in the message. The original message text is kept as a prefix, so any existing regex match on it still works.

query.intent: The IntervalArray._validate method checks that left <= right and raises a generic ValueError. It should be changed to compute which intervals violate the ordering and include the offending values or locations (limited to a few) in the error message.
query.symptom: Creating an IntervalArray/IntervalIndex (e.g. via from_breaks) with left > right raises a generic "left side of interval must be <= right side" ValueError without showing which values are offending.
anchors: left side of interval must be <= right side
